name: FormTo (Self-Hosted Form Backend)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted HTML form submission backend with a dashboard, CSV/JSON export, webhook and email notifications; no vendor-imposed submission quota or software subscription.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Docker Compose, PostgreSQL and hosting; SMTP and external integrations may incur charges. Public form endpoints have spam protection and rate limiting. Hosted infrastructure is not included.
